intro:
The way the pawn moves 

How can the pawn move in this diagram?
Click with the left mouse button on the squares to which the pawn can go in a single move. There could be one or several moves. Give all the moves.

If a move is a possible capture, then click on the piece which can be taken. A frame will appear around that piece.

When you have clicked on all possible moves, then click the [OK] button.
